review_candidates.title: Channel Sales Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Purpose of the Role : As a Channel Sales Manager , your will be responsible to drive the end-to-end revenue growth process with H3C Channel Partners, by cross and up selling, programs execution and adoption, success in promoting sales opportunities and strengthen the Partnership relationship. Responsibilities: Develop profitable business model based on market trends and competitor activity. At least 5 years' experience in a distribution and channel management role in the ICT-related industry.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: At least 5 years' experience in a distribution and channel management role in the ICT-related industry. Working proficiency in English, willing to travel Familiar with HPE/Aruba, DELL, Cisco, Juniper, Huawei, Inspur, TPLINK, or other local ICT brand’s channel business is preferred Experience in marketing and sales program is an added advantage.
